result:
This looks correct and complete. Everything matches the spec: `Session`, `otp_secret`s in config, `verificar_otp` (module-level lookup so it's monkeypatchable via `app.auth.verificar_otp`), `otp_header()` dependency documenting the `X-OTP` rule, `login()` with mandatory `otp`, and `/login` wired to the `otp` body field with 401 on failure.

Final summary: implemented TOTP-based 2FA per T1 — `app/config.py` now carries per-user `otp_secret`s, `app/auth.py` gained `verificar_otp`/`otp_header` and a mandatory `otp` param on `login()`, and `POST /login` (`app/routes_auth.py`) requires/validates it. Updated `tests/conftest.py` and `tests/test_auth.py` accordingly (added an `otp_for()` helper other agents' export-feature tests ended up reusing). Also fixed an unrelated one-line typo (`datetate`→`datetime`) in `app/consultas.py` that was blocking the whole shared test suite from importing — left the rest of that in-progress feature (from another concurrent agent) untouched. `uv run pytest` is green: 27 passed.
